description: Seven Beijing-3 satellite scenes support three-dimensional urban reconstruction around Shanghai Gymnasium in Xuhui District. The Aerospace Information Research Institute and its commercial partner describe image registration, pan-sharpening, rational-polynomial camera adjustment and bundle adjustment for acquisitions during 2021–2023. Two areas cover 0.73 and 0.25 square kilometres. ScienceDB identifies the resource under CC BY 4.0 for free reuse, although the inspected metadata does not specify the delivered image and camera-file formats. The collection can test building-geometry reconstruction for urban digital twins. Its small geographic coverage and satellite viewing geometry limit transfer to other cities, and it does not itself provide a validated citywide building model. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
name: A high-precision optical satellite remote sensing images dataset of the Xuhui district in Shanghai for urban three-dimensional reconstruction
